description.p: Drop a reMarkable export on the window and get Markdown back: headings, lists and all. The reading is done by a vision model running on this machine through llama-server, so no page of your handwriting is uploaded anywhere and no subscription is involved.

A notebook exports as one very tall image. Remarkable cuts it into overlapping bands at the gaps in the writing, reads each one in turn, and stitches the results back together, so a seventeen-thousand-pixel page comes back transcribed rather than summarised.
With the tablet in developer mode and plugged in over USB, notebooks can be listed and fetched straight off the device.
